item.title: Install Termorq
item.description:
Termorq is a Windows desktop app available from the Microsoft Store. It comes in two editions, Free and Pro, each with its own Store listing. Use a badge to open that edition in the Store and install it. See Free vs Pro for what each includes.

Termorq Free
Termorq Pro Paid

After installation, open Termorq from the Windows Start menu. Microsoft Store delivers app updates for the Store edition.

item.title: The window
item.description: The window is one prompt. A header runs across the top. Under the tabs, a full-width row names what this tab is connected to. The prompt is the next line after the output. A footer under the terminal names the shell, the folder, and the Agent switch. The inspector is the column on the right, from under that connection row to the bottom of the window, beside the footer. HTTP, MCP, models, and collections open in the terminal column.

item.title: Sample workspace
item.description:
Download acme-apis.zip and unpack it. The workspace contains no token. Its Users API points to mock://users, an offline demo host, so calls stay on this machine.

Open it in Termorq link

Open Termorq and type the path to the unzipped folder:

@workspace open ~/Downloads/acme-apis

Change the path if you unpacked the sample somewhere else. The Users API connection needs a secret before it can run. For this offline example, any non-empty value works; it is not sent over the network. Enter it in the app so it stays in the OS keychain.
